rationale: A plausible-sounding but false claim ocra made: skipping the logger for probe routes does not skip panic recovery. Checks that it is not reported. ADR-0036: stays forbid-only; the reason still holds at head (handler.go recovers panics for every route registered through app.add); base set to the merge base.

forbid.reason: Probe routes are wrapped by handler.ServeHTTP, which recovers panics itself (handler.go:79); skipping the logger middleware skips only logging.
